focus_areas: Continuity of the handrail segments (no floating parts)
Anchoring points of balusters into the concrete steps
Geometric consistency of the building architecture in the background

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points where the metal posts meet the concrete stairs. AI often fails to render realistic mounting hardware or fusion points. Also, scrutinize the upper building facade for warped perspective lines or inconsistent window geometries, as these are common architectural artifacts.
image_description: An outdoor concrete staircase leading up to a modern, brutalist-style building with dark cladding. The stairs are flanked by metal handrails (bannisters) on both sides. The left side features a more complex railing system with vertical supports and a curved top rail, while the right side has a simpler tubular metal handrail supported by thin posts. The background includes a grassy slope and trees under an overcast sky.

expert_testimonies.reason: To verify the 3D structural integrity of the railing posts anchoring into the concrete and the spatial relationship between the building and the stairs.
To confirm the object class is indeed a bannister/railing system and not just generic fencing.
To check for edge bleeding between the thin metal rails and the complex background (grass/building), ensuring they are continuous objects.
To assess the realism of the materials (concrete vs. metal) and identify any subtle textural inconsistencies missed by specific audits.
